chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily, your host.
Today, we are traveling to a small and beautiful city in Europe.
It is called Kuldiga.
Kuldiga is in Latvia, a country in northern Europe.
The city is full of history, old buildings and nature.
Let's explore Kuldiga together.
Part 2 – Where is Kuldiga?
Kuldiga is in western Latvia, near the Venta River.
It is far from big cities, so life is calm and peaceful.
The city has small streets, colorful houses and old bridges.
It is a perfect place to enjoy nature and history.
Part 3 – History of Kuldiga Kuldiga has a long history.
It was an important town in the Middle Ages.
The city was part of the Duchy of Corland.
Many old buildings and churches are still here today.
The old town is protected and very charming.
Part 4 – Main Attractions The most famous place in Kuldiga is the Venta Rapid, the widest waterfall in Europe.
There is also the Old Town Square with colorful houses.
You can see the old brick bridges, historic churches and small museums.
Walking in Kuldiga feels like traveling back in time.
Part 5 – The City of Kuldiga Kuldiga is small and very friendly.
There are cafes, local shops and restaurants.
People walk or ride bicycles in the streets.
The city is quiet, safe and full of charm.
Part 6 – Food in Kuldiga Food in Kuldiga is simple and tasty.
People eat potatoes, fish, meat and bread.
A popular dish is smoked fish from the Venta River.
Local bakeries make pastries and sweet cakes.
Part 7 – The People of Kuldiga People in Kuldiga are friendly and welcoming.
They speak Latvian and some people speak English for visitors.
Life is slow and traditions are important.
People enjoy music, crafts and local festivals.
Part 8 – Culture and Festivals Kuldiga has many festivals in summer and winter.
People celebrate music, dance and local traditions.
Folk music is common and people wear traditional clothes in festivals.
Visitors can join and enjoy the celebrations.
Part 9 – Nature Around Kuldiga Kuldiga is near forests, rivers and fields.
You can go hiking, cycling or just walk along the Venta River.
The air is fresh and nature is very peaceful.
It is a great place to relax and enjoy the outdoors.
Part 10 – Travel and Tourism Kuldiga is small but reachable by bus or car from bigger cities in Latvia.
Tourists come to see the old town, the waterfall and local museums.
Tourism helps local people earn money and keep traditions alive.
Part 11 – Daily Life in Kuldiga Life in Kuldiga is calm and simple.
People wake up early, go to work or school and spend time with family.
Children play in the streets and families enjoy walks by the river.
Life feels natural and connected to history.
Part 12 – Why Kuldiga is Special Kuldiga is not a famous city, but it is full of charm and nature.
It combines history, old buildings and peaceful life beautifully.
Visitors feel relaxed and enjoy the beauty of this hidden European gem.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emili and I hope you enjoyed this journey through Kuldiga Latvia.
See you next time.
Goodbye for now.
